source_caption_text:
Me after giving her the best 2 weeks of her life

The Weeknd delivered one of the most memorable performances of “Save Your Tears” at the 2021 Billboard Music Awards. He performed in an empty Los Angeles parking lot, sitting on a red convertible while a group of cars drove around him in tight formation.

As the song went on, the performance got even crazier with massive 18-wheelers speeding past him. Somehow, The Weeknd stayed completely locked in vocally while all the cars and trucks moved around him.

The performance also marked the end of his *After Hours* era, with The Weeknd trading the red suit and bandages for a black suit, beard and sunglasses. It was a perfect way to close out one of his biggest eras before moving into his next chapter.
